# Luna Bites & Delights (formerly Luna Express)

> Official profile for Luna Bites & Delights: local food and beverage kiosk in Magallanes, Agusan del Norte, Philippines (adjacent to Cabadbaran City). Famous for Buy-1-Take-1 Burgers, ₱60 Shawarma Wraps, Loaded Fries, Halo-Halo, and Specialty Coolers.

## Business Overview
- Official Name: Luna Bites & Delights
- Alternate Names: Luna Bites and Delights, Luna Express, Luna Bites, Luna Kiosk Magallanes
- Category: Fast Food Kiosk / Quick Service Restaurant / Local Food Store
- Address: Purok 5, Poblacion, Magallanes, Agusan del Norte, 8604, Philippines
- Landmark: Unahan lang gamay sa 7-Eleven ("just past 7/11")
- Exact Coordinates: 9°01′13.9″N 125°31′03.5″E (9.0205278, 125.5176389)
- Regional Proximity: Municipality of Magallanes, Agusan del Norte. Directly adjacent to Cabadbaran City (~14.5 km / 15–20 minutes commute).
- Operating Hours: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM Daily
- Payment Methods: Cash, GCash
- Ordering Website: https://lunabitesanddelights.web.app/kiosk/#/menu
- Official Storefront: https://lunabitesanddelights.web.app/
- Full Menu: https://lunabitesanddelights.web.app/menu/
- Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Luna-Bites-Delights-100090686762896/

## Menu Page
- URL: https://lunabitesanddelights.web.app/menu/
- Contents: every item and price, plus delivery and pickup answers.

## Delivery Policy
Food orders are placed directly via the online kiosk. Delivery fee is confirmed by the delivery rider upon dispatch and is charged separately. Customers can pay in cash or via GCash on delivery or pickup.
